description: Set or clear the in and out points of clip project items, as marking them in the Source Monitor does (Markers > Mark In, Mark Out, Clear In and Out). Used to choose the part of a clip to edit in, or to line up camera angles for synchronising. One undo step

clear.description: Clear both points (Clear In and Out)

inPoint.description: In point, seconds into the media

item.description: A project item: its id (from list_project_items), its bin path such as "Footage/Interviews/a.mov", or its name when that is unique

name.description: Item name, when only one item has it

path.description: Bin path, "/"-separated, from the project root

items.description: Several clip project items instead of item
